title: Haemophilus Influenzae Infection — StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf, NBK562176)

claims.text: H. influenzae type b (Hib) accounts for 95% of invasive disease in children and >50% of invasive disease in adults.
claims.byte_quote: H. influenzae type b (Hib) is noteworthy because of its polyribosyl ribitol phosphate (PRP) capsule, which accounts for 95% of invasive disease in children and >50% of invasive disease in adults.

claims.text: Invasive Hib infection occurs commonly in children under 5 years of age and includes pneumonia and meningitis.
claims.byte_quote: The invasive Hib infection occurs commonly in children under 5 years of age and mainly includes pneumonia and meningitis.

claims.text: After Hib conjugate vaccine introduction, the majority of invasive H. influenzae disease is now caused by non-typeable strains (NTHi), which also cause meningitis.
claims.byte_quote: NTHi is responsible for invasive infections like bacteremia without identifiable focus, bacteremic pneumonia, and meningitis.

claims.text: In 2017, incidence per 100,000 children under 5 was 0.18 for Hib, 1.7 for non-b H. influenzae, and 1.7 for non-typeable H. influenzae.
claims.byte_quote: In 2017, the incidence rate was 0.18 for Hib, 1.7 for non-b H. influenzae , and 1.7 for non-typeable H. influenzae per 100,000 population of children younger than 5 years of age.

claims.text: H. influenzae is a small, facultatively anaerobic, pleomorphic, capnophilic gram-negative coccobacillus of the family Pasteurellaceae.
claims.byte_quote: Haemophilus influenzae is characterized as a small (0.3 micrometer to 1 micrometer), facultatively anaerobic, pleomorphic, and capnophilic gram-negative coccobacillus of the family Pasteurellaceae

claims.text: Gram staining of body-fluid samples reveals pleomorphic gram-negative coccobacilli.
claims.byte_quote: The initial test is Gram staining, which reveals pleomorphic gram-negative coccobacilli.

claims.text: In Hib meningitis, the capsular antigen is detected in 90% of patients and 80% demonstrate a positive CSF Gram stain.
claims.byte_quote: The capsular antigen is detected in 90% of patients, and 80% demonstrate a positive CSF gram stain.

claims.text: Hib meningitis often shows marked pleocytosis with neutrophil predominance, decreased CSF glucose, and elevated protein.
claims.byte_quote: Hib meningitis often shows a marked pleocytosis with neutrophil predominance. The glucose levels in the CSF are decreased, and protein levels are elevated.
